reviews.text: Jonathan (mobile groomer) has been grooming my fur baby for a long time.  Mia always looks and feels fantastic after her spa time with him.  Thank you🐶
Everything was excellent, the only thing I didn't like was that they don't bathe him.

Hi Marc, we’re so glad you had a great experience with our dog grooming service. It means a lot to hear your pup left looking and feeling their best. Our team at Rapawzel Dog Grooming & Day Care loves giving each pet personalized care from start to finish.

Michel is fantastic! He provides a wonderful mobile service, and my girl feels so comfortable with him. He is gentle, patient, and truly has a special way with dogs. There may be a little language barrier, but he is absolutely a dog whisperer! He handled my girl with such kindness and care. Highly recommend Michel! 🐾❤️
Loved the kindness in which grooming was done and the end look was exactly as planned!

Ciara has started using Rapawzel recently for her grooming needs such as a mani, pedi, oatmeal bath, and ear cleaning. Shes an elderly dog and seems to like it. She smells super, her nails are clipped nicely. The staff is very cordial and courteous.
The environment is clean and the price is very reasonable.

My Shiba went to them for a bath and brushing -  they shaved her! Their staff should have known  NEVER do that to a dog with a double coat. My friend took my dog there for me and agreed to having them trim the feathery fur along her  back legs - period. Yes they gave me back my money - but my dog has a miserable winter ahead of her.

Hi Isabel, we’re so glad your dog had a great experience with our dog grooming service. Our team at Rapawzel Dog Grooming & Day Care loves making pets feel calm, clean, and comfortable. It means a lot that you trusted us with your pup’s care.

Hi Tracy Nicole Noel, we loved caring for your pup during dog grooming at Rapawzel Dog Grooming & Day Care. It means a lot to know the visit felt comfortable and personalized. We’re grateful you chose our pet spa team here in the community.
Excellent service, they made Drake look beautiful 🥰
From start to finish this service was amazing ! Thank you for taking care of my German shepherd !!

I have been a mobile grooming customer of Rapawzel for many years now.  They groomed my late dog, and now my current dog.  Well the DAY BEFORE they were supposed to arrive they cancelled my appointment and said they were no longer servicing my neighborhood go forward.  This is highly unprofessional behavior, they should have at least given me a few weeks notice.  It's such a shame because the man that cuts his hair is so good and so talented, he should open his own business rather than work for this terrible company.
Great experience. My dog looks fantastic. Very kind groomer. Will definitely book again. So happy and so is my doggy.

Miguel was prompt and professional. He was patient and kind with my French Doodle Benji. Miguel groomed Benji correctly based on my instructions.

The second photo represents Benji being groomed by Fabricio Borges. Benji was extremely happy to see him again! Fabricio Borges was patient and kind with handling Benji. I think the tie was a nice added touch!
Michel was thorough when he serviced my dog. I’m pleased with how my dog looks and smells. Sad to say 2 weeks later we had to put our baby down. He wasn’t the same afterwards.

Hi Jessica, we’re so glad you had a great experience with our dog grooming service at Rapawzel Dog Grooming & Day Care. It means a lot to know your pup left looking and feeling their best. We love caring for pets in the community and hope to see you both again soon.
Great experience with mobile grooming! On time and professional. Convenient and great job
Thankyou Luciana great job

I am VERY happy with Baileys grooming. Bruno was professional and easy to communicate with. I showed him a pic of what she normally looks like and he nailed it!! The cut was perfect. And she was so fluffy and nice after her grooming. THANK YOU for your service and huge Thanks to Bruno. I would hope we get him as our groomer again. He’s definitely an asset to Rapawzel. Keep up the good job.
My baby was taken care of by one of the nicest people.  He looked fabulous when he was finished.
